description: Systematically construct Turing machines that implement shift overflow counter patterns, which are known to produce the highest-scoring BB(6) machines. Design TMs from the top down based on the counter structure.
mathematical_formalization: SOC(n) implements binary counter with overflow detection: T(counter_state) -> 2^counter_width steps per overflow
analogical_connections: Binary ripple carry adders in hardware
implementation_hypothesis: Enumerate all possible counter-based 6-state TMs by fixing the counter increment/overflow states and varying the reset/halt logic
experiment_seed: Construct machines with 2-bit, 3-bit, 4-bit counter patterns and measure sigma scores
